title: Multi-particle quantum systems within the Worldline Monte Carlo formalism
abstract: Extends the Worldline Monte Carlo computational method to simulate Feynman path integrals for multi-particle non-relativistic quantum systems. Demonstrates generation of multiple worldlines distributed according to free kinetic dynamics and simulation of inter-worldline interactions. Validated against exact Hamiltonian diagonalization. The approach is numerically exact, computationally efficient, and scales more favorably than numerical diagonalization with respect to discretization points and spatial dimensions.
key_claims: First extension of worldline Monte Carlo to multi-particle systems
Scales more favorably than numerical diagonalization
Validated against exact diagonalization for 2- and 3-particle systems
Immediately adaptable to relativistic quantum systems
Universal applicability: trajectory ensemble independent of potential
